description:
Social Media Executive
   

  

 Company: Creative Logix Studio
   

 Location: Delhi NCR
   

 Work Mode: Hybrid
   

 Working Days: 5 Days a Week
   

 Salary: ₹10,000 – ₹15,000/month for the first 3 months, based on experience \& performance
   

  

 About the Role
   

  

 Creative Logix Studio is looking for an experienced and proactive Social Media Executive who can independently manage social media accounts, handle clients, and plan \& execute monthly content calendars.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 \- Manage social media accounts for multiple clients.
   

 \- Handle client communication and understand their requirements.
   

 \- Prepare and manage monthly content calendars for Posts, Reels, Stories and campaigns.
   

 \- Coordinate with designers, video editors, photographers and the internal team.
   

 \- Schedule and publish content on Instagram, Facebook and other platforms.
   

 \- Write engaging captions and identify relevant hashtags, keywords and trends.
   

 \- Monitor social media performance and prepare basic monthly reports.
   

 \- Stay updated with Instagram trends, Reels formats, trending audio and algorithms.
   

 \- Ensure content is delivered and posted according to the approved calendar.
   

 \- Take client feedback and coordinate revisions with the creative team.
   

 \- Assist in developing social media strategies for client growth and engagement.
   

  

 Requirements
   

  

 \- Prior experience in social media management and client handling is mandatory.
   

 \- Strong understanding of Instagram, Facebook and other social media platforms.
   

 \- Good knowledge of monthly content calendar planning and execution.
   

 \- Excellent communication and client\-handling skills.
   

 \- Understanding of social media trends, Reels, captions, hashtags and basic SEO.
   

 \- Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines.
   

 \- Good coordination and organizational skills.
   

 \- Basic Canva knowledge is an added advantage.
   

 \- Must be proactive, responsible and comfortable working in a fast\-paced agency environment.
   

  

 Important Eligibility
   

  

 \- Candidates must be based in Delhi NCR.
   

 \- Candidates from outside Delhi NCR will not be considered.
   

 \- Hybrid work mode.
   

 \- 5 working days per week.
   

 \- Candidates should be comfortable attending the office whenever required.
   

  

 Salary \& Growth
   

  

 \- ₹10,000 – ₹15,000/month for the first 3 months, depending on experience and performance.
   

 \- Salary revision/growth opportunities after the initial 3 months based on performance.
   

 \- Opportunity to work with multiple brands and businesses.
   

 \- Hands\-on experience in social media strategy, content planning and client management.
   

  

 How to Apply
   

  

 Share your CV \+ previous social media work/portfolio along with details of your relevant experience.

title: Performance Marketing Executive
description:
Position: Performance Marketing Exceutive
 



 Location: Nx One, Greater Noida 
 



 Experience: 1–3 Years
 



 Working Days: 6 days, Sat \- WFH 
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 



1. Manage and optimize Facebook \& Instagram (Meta) Ads.
2. Plan, launch, and monitor paid advertising campaigns.
3. Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns.
4. Conduct audience, keyword, and competitor research.
5. Monitor key metrics such as ROAS, CPA, CPC, CTR, CPM, and conversions.
6. Optimize campaigns to improve sales, conversions, and ROAS.
7. Test different audiences, creatives, ad copies, and campaign strategies.
8. Identify winning products, creatives, and audiences for scaling.
9. Assist in product research based on market demand and customer trends.
10. Research competitors, pricing, customer reviews, and market trends.
11. Identify potential products with strong sales and scaling opportunities.
12. Analyze existing product performance and suggest improvements.
13. Work closely with the creative and marketing team to develop performance\-driven ad creatives.
14. Provide feedback on ad creatives, hooks, messaging, and customer pain points.
15. Track and report campaign performance on a daily/weekly basis.
16. Identify underperforming campaigns and take corrective actions.
17. Stay updated with the latest Meta and Google Ads trends and strategies.



**Requirements** 



1. 1–3 years of experience in Meta Ads and Google Ads.
2. Hands\-on experience in performance marketing.
3. Understanding of ROAS, CPA, CPC, CTR, CPM, and conversion tracking.
4. Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
5. Good understanding of D2C/E\-commerce marketing.
6. Ability to conduct product and competitor research.
7. Comfortable working with numbers and performance data.
8. Strong communication and coordination skills.
9. Ability to work independently and take ownership.
10. Willingness to test, learn, and experiment with new strategies.

title: Sales and Marketing Intern
description:
**Sales and Marketing Intern** 




**Company: ITIO Innovex Pvt. Ltd.** 




**Location: Kaushambi, Ghaziabad** 




**Duration: 3 Months** 




**Type: Internship (with potential full\-time placement)** 




  





**About the Company** 




 At ITIO Innovex Pvt. Ltd., we believe in nurturing young talent and providing real\-world exposure that bridges the gap between academic learning and professional careers. Our Placement\-Integrated Internship Program offers hands\-on experience, mentorship, and the opportunity to transition into a full\-time role based on performance.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 




**As a LinkedIn Marketing Intern, you will:** 



* Assist with day\-to\-day LinkedIn marketing activities and campaign execution.
* Work on live projects, supporting marketing initiatives and brand promotion.
* Help in content creation and scheduling for LinkedIn posts.
* Conduct market research and competitor analysis.
* Support the team with lead generation and client communication through LinkedIn.
* Participate in training sessions and workshops to enhance technical and professional skills.
* Maintain professionalism and adhere to company policies and guidelines.



  





**Eligibility Criteria** 




**We are looking for candidates who:** 



* Are currently pursuing or recently graduated in Marketing, Business Administration, IT, or a related field.
* Have strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Show a proactive attitude and eagerness to learn.
* Possess good time\-management and multitasking abilities.
* Have a problem\-solving mindset and the ability to contribute innovative ideas.



  





**Internship Benefits** 



* 3\-month internship with real\-world industry experience
* Mentorship from experienced professionals
* Stipend: ₹10,000 per month (Fixed)
* Full\-time placement opportunity for high\-performing interns
* Certificate of Completion after successful internship completion
* Opportunity to develop technical and professional skills
